headline: Shanghai Friday: Jodar-Ruud and Medvedev-Paul, no score posted
whyCareReason: ATP lists both quarterfinals for Friday 16 October. The results page still stops at Thursday.
teaser: Not before 14:30: Rafael Jodar vs Casper Ruud. Not before 18:00: Daniil Medvedev vs Tommy Paul. No winner is printed.
story: The ATP order of play for Friday 16 October at the Rolex Shanghai Masters puts Rafael Jodar against Casper Ruud not before 14:30, then Daniil Medvedev against Tommy Paul not before 18:00, both on Stadium Court. The results page has not added either match. Wednesday is in: Jodar beat van de Zandschulp 6-7 (4), 6-4, 6-2. Ruud led Auger-Aliassime 5-2 when Auger-Aliassime retired. Medvedev beat Tsitsipas 6-4, 7-5. Paul beat Bergs 7-6 (5), 6-4. This card stays upcoming.
stakes: The winners meet in the other semifinal. Zverev and Davidovich Fokina are already through on the opposite side.
rivalryAngle: Ruud has now reached the quarterfinals at all nine Masters 1000 events, per the ATP report on his win over Auger-Aliassime.
funFacts: Friday order: Jodar (12) vs Ruud (20), not before 14:30.
Then Medvedev (5) vs Paul (15), not before 18:00.
No Friday score is on the ATP results page.

keyPlayers.name: Rafael Jodar
keyPlayers.hook: Beat van de Zandschulp 6-7 (4), 6-4, 6-2 to reach the quarterfinal.

resultSummary: UPCOMING: Jodar vs Ruud, then Medvedev vs Paul. ATP has not posted a Friday score.
